field_grades.button: inferred (idx 2 = X findings/owner, idx 1 = Y Kakashi side Y, idx 0 = B and idx 3 = SELECT from the ground move reader's mask-to-move mapping)
field_grades.confirmed: independent (guide, capture or owner), cite given
field_grades.disarm: inferred (marker -1 empties the slot: sub 3 stores the arg, the slot loop skips -1)
field_grades.ground_wait: inferred (an anim with a sub 3 event that arms a marker)
field_grades.guide_check: measured join: the guide tag text against the scanner's anims for the mapped prefixes
field_grades.input_conditional: inferred (an anim with an input or state branch: sub 0, 1, 5, 9, 14, 18 or 23)
field_grades.kind: inferred (semantics of each field: press count over a window, jump to marker)
field_grades.tiers: STATIC (anim_events.decode_branch/resolve_branch: descending thresholds and marker frames)

grade_notes.air_wait: measured bytes; semantics inferred from the handler (queue kind 4: fires while NOT grounded); not modeled in mash_path.py
grade_notes.branches: STATIC: sub 5 contact_wait, sub 9 counter_wait and sub 14 deck_count_branch reuse anim_events.py decode_branch/resolve_branch; marker_frame is null for contact disarm or a missing marker. Sub 14 tiers keep descending min_count, marker and frame. Semantics: docs/research/2026-10-15-taikoubou-6kx-branches.md sections 2-3 and docs/research/findings/p230-kenshin-status-counter-sound.md; no live measurement.
grade_notes.button: button index is measured; the history mask is measured (table 0x02171098 low halfword); name X for idx 2 is the findings/owner reading, Y for idx 1 is inferred from Kakashi side Y; idx 0 = B (0x80) and idx 3 = SELECT (0x1000) follow the ground move reader (0x0215A7CC tests 0x1000 for move id 11), read statically
grade_notes.bytes: measured: the event bytes, read from the character's motion table (raw)
grade_notes.counter_wait: STATIC: sub 9, handler 0x02155DB8 queues kind 9 in slot 2; signed marker ev[2], -1 disarms. Poll 0x021564E8 tests ColPrm+0x40 & 0x20000; p230-kenshin-status-counter-sound.md
grade_notes.direction: lead: marker per d-pad direction read from the handler; direction names not resolved
grade_notes.ends: measured: frames of the op 3 sub 1 end-key events (handler 0x0215693C sets ctrl+0x90 bit 0x10000000); inferred: the move ends 2 ticks after the playhead reaches the first one, else at frames + 3 (5 of 5 measured idles: Train side Y 51 = 49+2, up Y 45 = 43+2, air Y 60 = 58+2, Yusuke side Y 53 = 51+2, Kakashi UA 60 = (34 + 24 loop frames) + 2)
grade_notes.fields: measured bytes at the measured offsets: marker, limit, button, window, threshold
grade_notes.ground_wait: measured bytes; inferred semantics: arms slot 0 (queue kind 2, grounded test 0x021562E8) with marker ev[2]; the slot loop jumps there from any frame once grounded; arg -1 disarms
grade_notes.hold_release: unverified: a sub 1 with no hold tier set. button ev[2], default Marker ev[4]. Static trace (unverified live): a level poll from the tick after creation that fires on the first tick the button is not down (0x02161440).
grade_notes.hold_tiers: lead: the field mapping follows the slot copy in the sub-1 handler; matches the Yusuke/Kakashi X charge thresholds in OWNER-NOTES.md but is not traced end to end
grade_notes.layout: measured: each field's byte offset is the immediate of the ldrb/ldrsb/ldrh in the handler (code_facts.layout, ARM addresses in code_facts.sites)
grade_notes.loop: measured bytes; inferred semantics: an unconditional jump to marker ev[2] through the shared counter (0x021561A8) with limit ev[3]; -1 never bumps or blocks
grade_notes.marker_frame: measured: the anim's Marker track key whose marker equals the field; null if absent
grade_notes.move: inferred: ids 1-12 are the global move table (cancel_table.move_table) anim; X and up X are the anim-timing.json rows (anims 0x29-0x2E), per-fighter byte not read
grade_notes.semantics: inferred: what a field means (press count over a window of input-history frames, a jump queued to the marker) follows from the handler code read statically and the ov6 handlers 0x02155A04 (sub 0) and 0x02155A84 (sub 18), and the eve-specials README (docs/research/feel-captures/2026-10-12-eve-specials/README.md); live checks are in confirmed
grade_notes.store: measured bytes: ev[2] (signed) is written to the team's controller byte ctrl+0xA3 (0x021560EC); what the stored value means is the UA scanner's concern
grade_notes.stored_jump: measured: reads no event byte. If ctrl+0xA3 != -1 it queues a jump to that marker and clears it to -1 (0x021560F8); `targets` is every marker of the anim, not a join
